description: Viscera Cleanup Detail: clean levels, unlock more levels.

1.0.0.description:
# Viscera Cleanup Detail Archipelago - First Release

**What gets randomized**
- 26 (Base + DLC) levels, each behind its own access item. Configure how many start unlocked, trim the level pool, or play a random subset each seed.
- Per-level checks: a cleanliness milestone ladder (every 5% by default), Employee of the Month at 100%, a Punch Out check, optional Speedrun checks, and optional rungs past 100%, going up to the max minus some margin.
- Toolsanity (on by default): each level's tools (hands, welder, shovel, J-HARM, vendor, incinerator) are items too, and logic knows exactly what every toolkit can clean. You start with a mop + buckets, unless you opt to randomize the starting kit too.
- 39 collectibles and 6 Bob notes are checks: bank them in your trunk and punch out in good standing.
- Three goals: complete x amount of levels, find Bob or bank collectibles.
- Optional traps (mess dumps, spilled buckets, speed changes, a magnet pull), bin/bucket drops, death link, and trap link.
- Per-level Self-Cleaning Mop and Squeaky Clean Boots convenience items.

**Comfort**
- The client installs the precompiled mod into your game automatically, isolates each seed's saves from your career, and launches the game for you. Just pick your install folder and you are good to go.
- In-game messages mirror the Archipelago text client and a live cleaned % plus the next milestone sit in the top-right corner.
- Co-op works.
- Universal Tracker supported.

1.1.0.description:
# Viscera Cleanup Detail 1.1.0

- **Revolutionary Robotics laser welder** for 100% cleaned. Without it, now max 80% is in logic.
- **Uprinsing vendor and welder** for 100% cleaned, 80% otherwise.
- **The punch-out report can fill itself** (new yaml option auto_fill_punchout_report). Use the punch-out machine once to fill it in, and each PID entered into it will also auto-fill itself.

**Upgrading**
- Existing yamls keep working untouched.

1.2.0.description:
# Viscera Cleanup Detail 1.2.0

**New**
- **Useful item: Lit lantern**, next to the bucket and bin. Screw you, Penumbra
- **New yaml option `mop_start_self_cleaning_mop`** (on by default). With `random_starting_kit` on, a level that rolls the easy mop and Slosh-O-Matic start also starts with its Self-Cleaning Mop, so the mop never needs rinsing. It is the mirror of the hard start's Squeaky Clean Boots.
- **`/deathlink` and `/traplink` client toggles.** Each takes `on`, `off` or `seed`, and a bare command flips the current state.
- **`/autoplay` client toggle.**

**Logic**
- **Penumbra without hands tops out at 40 percent.** Level's too difficult man.

**Fixes**
- **Dirty buckets don't count negatively for the cleaned%.** While a level's incinerator is locked there is nowhere dispose of dirty buckets, so the buckets you fill no longer count against your cleaned percentage. They count again the moment the Incinerator item arrives.
- **A co-op guest leaving no longer kills the rest.** Quitting out registered as a death and, with death link on, swept every janitor in the session, host included.
- **Loading a save no longer banks milestone checks you did not earn.** A level restores its mess a moment after the load, and the old probe read that gap as a near-spotless room.
- **Coming back from a break no longer floods the level.** A pending backlog now hands you the newest few of each supply and drops the rest, instead of dropping one item per second for as long as the queue lasts. (So if you are 200 items pending, youll only get the progression checks and some usefuls)

**Upgrading**
- Existing yamls keep working untouched. `mop_start_self_cleaning_mop` defaults on and only does anything with `random_starting_kit` on.
